headline: Special permit applications for a Walmart warehouse at 256 Pleasant St. and a garage addition at 11 Tobey Ave.
summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals will consider a special permit for a proposed warehouse use at 256 Pleasant St. (Walmart) and a special permit for a 2 car garage addition at 11 Tobey Ave. The board will also accept the 2027 meeting schedule.
items: Applications for Special Permit: 2026-15 Walmart - Special Permit for proposed Warehouse use at 256 Pleasant St., Methuen MA 01844, in a BL (Limited Business) Zoning District (Parcel ID: 812-59-100)

Applications for Special Permit: 2026-16 Rui Costa for John and Jessica Musumarra - Special Permit for a new 2 car garage with mudroom entry at 11 Tobey Ave, Methuen, MA 01844; requested side yard setback of 7.7 feet where 15 feet is required; requested rear yard setback of 16.7 feet where 20 feet is required, Residential B Zoning District (Parcel ID: 1107-78A-50)
Acceptance of 2027 Zoning Board of Appeals Meeting Schedule
location: The Great Hall, 41 Pleasant St, Methuen, MA 01844
plain_text:
CITY OF METHUEN 
ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS 
THE SEARLES BUILDING 
41 PLEASANT ST, ROOM 203 
METHUEN, MA 01844 
 
MEETING AGENDA 
41 PLEASANT ST, THE GREAT HALL 
Wednesday October 28, 2026 at 7:00 PM 
 
1) Pledge of Allegiance 
2) Roll call 
3) Acceptance of Minutes: 
a) September 23,2026 
4) Acceptance of 2027 Zoning Board of Appeals Meeting Schedule 
5) New Business: 
a) Applications for Special Permit: 
 
i) 2026-15 Walmart 
A Special Permit is required under Section V -D (table of use regulations) of the May 2025 Comprehensive Zoning 
Ordinance of the City of Methuen, in a BL (Limited Business) Zoning District, for the proposed Warehouse use at 
256 Pleasant St., Methuen MA 01844 (Parcel ID: 812-59-100). 
 
ii) 2026-16 Rui Costa for John and Jessica Musumarra 
Under section IX-E of the May 2025 Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance of the City of Methuen, a Special permit is 
required from the Board of Appeals.  A proposed new 2 car garage, with mudroom entry, the requested side yard 
setback of the proposed extension to a nonconforming structure is 7.7 feet, where 15 feet is required; the 
requested rear yard setback is 16.7 feet, where 20 feet is required at 11 TOBEY AVE, METHUEN, MA 01844, 
RESIDENTIAL B ZONING DISTRICT (PARCEL ID: 1107-78A-50)  
6) Adjournment 
 
NEXT ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS MEETING: November 18, 2026 
Accessibility Notice 
Anyone needing an access accommodation to participate in City of Methuen programs or services, please 
contact Felix Garcia, ADA Coordinator at 978-983-8545 or fgarcia@methuen.gov at least 2 weeks in 
advance, or 2 business days before any Board or Commission meeting. This notice is available in 
alternative formats upon request. 
For this meeting, members of the public who wish to watch the meeting may do so on their televisions by turning to 
Comcast Xfinity Channel 8 or Verizon FiOS Channel 32 or view on a computer or cell phone via live stream at 
https://www.methuentv.org/methuen-government-tv-live-stream/.  
Public participation will be opened during the meeting for those wishing to attend. In lieu of attending in person, to 
participate in the public hearing, email questions/comments by noon on July 21,2026 to LMoriarty@methuen.gov . 
Questions/comments will be provided to the Board, added the record and responded to accordingly.
